summary: Tractor Supply Company filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 on November 5, 2026, disclosing that its board declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.24 per share of common stock. The dividend is payable December 8, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business on November 23, 2026. The filing furnished the related press release as Exhibit 99.1; no advisor, premium, or structural mechanics were disclosed. This is a routine capital-return declaration rather than a special situation, with no deal terms or risk-arb angle to monitor.
